d:
Welcome to the final episode of our Albania travel series, and we couldn’t have chosen a better place to end it. In this video, we explore Komani Lake, often called the “Thailand of Europe” for its dramatic mountains, emerald waters, and untouched natural beauty.
Our journey includes an incredible boat ride on Komani Lake, followed by a scenic river tour through one of Albania’s most peaceful and remote regions. Along the way, we soak in the serene nature, breathtaking landscapes, and enjoy local Albanian food surrounded by pure tranquility.
